articles.title: Isro at core of India's space programme: IN-SPACe Chairman Pawan Goenka
articles.summary: Pawan Goenka, IN-SPACe Chairman, affirmed ISRO remains the bedrock of India's space sector, its role undiminished despite growing private participation. ISRO will continue focusing on advanced research, development, and foundational missions, while IN-SPACe facilitates private industry's involvement. This ensures India's space ambitions are met through both public and private strengths, crucial for national progress.
